name: Joseon Jojiso paper production office
description: A government paper manufactory called Jojiso was established in Joseon in 1415, according to a modern study of the office.

impact.note: One government manufactory that improved supply and control of paper for a state, without known successors resting on it.

date.label: 1415, reported establishment
date.basis: Date of the stated witness or contextual sample, not a claim of global origin.

events.statement: A government paper manufactory called Jojiso was established in Joseon in 1415, according to a modern study of the office.

evidence.supports: The English abstract says Jojiso was established in 1415 to manufacture paper for government and tribute and to practice and improve paper techniques; it reports renaming in 1466 and discusses oversight of quality and local manufacturers over the office history.

events.caveats: The 1415 date is institutional establishment as reported by the study, not the beginning of Korean papermaking. The reviewed English abstract describes the office over a longer period; its staffing and practices cannot automatically be dated to 1415.

earliest_record.rationale: This dated witness represents the scoped case, not global priority.
